<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the compound shows a Br isotopic pattern (M and M+2 peaks of similar intensity) with a [M+H]+ ion at m/z ≈ 199, corresponding to a neutral formula C₈H₇BrO (DBE = 5). This fits a brominated acetophenone (bromo‑acetophenone). The para‑substituted isomer is a reasonable candidate. Its SMILES is “Brc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)C”.</thought>
<final_answer>Brc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)C</final_answer>
